article.hook: A task nags at you until it’s flawless. Mars in Virgo is the itch under your skin that pushes you to sharpen, adjust, and perfect. It’s not about rushing - it’s about getting it right before you move on.
article.lived: Over the next six weeks, you’ll notice your energy drilling into details others skip. You straighten the skewed picture frame, tighten a loose screw, or rewrite a paragraph until it clicks. Your drive shows up as practical action - quiet, exact, and almost surgical. Every effort feels like it must serve a purpose, not just fill space.
article.turn: The problem comes when you zero in on the tiny flaws and lose sight of the whole. You might rewrite emails five times or reorganize a project endlessly while the bigger goals slip away. Perfection becomes your excuse to stall or criticize - stop polishing and start moving.
moves: Choose one small task and finish it fully today, no tweaks after.
Turn off notifications when you work to cut distraction before it breeds doubt.
List three priorities and let go of anything below your top two until this transit ends.
